subject: Acme security evidence request — tenant crypto isolation & rotation timeline
messages:
From: Jane Wright <jane.wright@acme-corp.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2028-05-03T16:12:00Z
Subject: Request: evidence for tenant crypto isolation and rotation (SIG/SOC2)

Hi Sofia / David,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our security team is preparing a SIG/SOC 2 review and we need a short bundle of artifacts focused on encryption and key management for multi-tenant environments. Specifically, could you provide the following by EOD May 5?

- A short attestation or vendor HSM certificate that demonstrates Hardware Root of Trust for customer key material.
- Rotation timeline (last 12 months) for wrapping keys / envelope keys used for tenant encryption; a redacted audit log is fine if it preserves rotation timestamps and operator IDs.
- Key custody matrix: who within Redwood has the ability to perform rotation and emergency rewraps (roles, not raw IAM ARNs).
- Clarification on tenant isolation: whether per-tenant envelope keys are used or a shared wrapping key with per-tenant data keys.

If you prefer, a short Playbook PDF and an index file pointing to the artifacts in a shared folder will work. We have a hard cut-off for the SIG intake on May 7, so anything earlier is helpful.

Regards,
Jane Wright
Technical Program Manager — Security Programs
Acme Corp

Attachments: none
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Wright <jane.wright@acme-corp.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-03T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for tenant crypto isolation and rotation (SIG/SOC2)

Hi Jane —

Thanks for the clear list. We can get this to you. High-level answers up front:

- HSM attestation: we will provide the vendor-signed attestation (FIPS/HSM vendor cert) for our HSM cluster used for key wrapping.
- Rotation: Redwood performs scheduled rotations for envelope-wrapping keys on a quarterly cadence and emergency rotations as required; we will include a redacted rotation log with operator IDs and timestamps covering the last 12 months.
- Tenant isolation model: we use per-tenant data keys (DEKs) that are envelope-wrapped by a smaller set of rotating master-wrapping keys; DEKs are generated per-tenant and never exported in plaintext. I will include an architecture note and a short sequence diagram.
- Custody matrix: we will provide a role-based matrix listing which teams/roles can initiate rotations or request emergency rewraps (CS, SRE, Security ops).

I am attaching an artifact index and a rotation summary PDF to this email for your review. Full raw logs and the signed HSM attestation are too sensitive for email; we will share those in the secure Drive folder and a temporary pre-signed S3 bundle once we have an NDA or while we work the SIG pact. If you need raw audit records instead of the redacted timeline, confirm and we'll produce a separate export with stricter access controls.

Proposed schedule:
- May 3 (today): index + summary (attached)
- May 4: HSM attestation + rotation CSV (redacted) uploaded to Drive link
- May 5: key custody matrix + optional raw logs if requested

Does that timeline work?

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Security Programs Lead, Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood-artifact-index.csv (CSV)
- rotation-summary-2027-2028.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-03T17:02:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: evidence for tenant crypto isolation and rotation (SIG/SOC2)

Ben — forwarding Acme's ask (see thread below). Can you take point on collecting the rotation CSV and the HSM attestation? Details:

- Rotation CSV: include rotation_id, key_id (wrapped ID), rotation_timestamp, operator_role (redacted to role), reason (scheduled|emergency). Do NOT include raw DEK material or plaintext keys.
- HSM attestation: vendor PDF (already in our secure repo), need signature page and serial that maps to our key domain.
- Key custody matrix: produce an XLSX with role descriptions and JIT break-glass process.

Timeline: deliver manifests to me by EOD May 4 so I can review and upload to the Drive folder and send to Acme on May 5. If you need someone from infra to pull logs, loop in David.

Thanks — this is time-sensitive.
Sofia

Date: 2028-05-05T22:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for tenant crypto isolation and rotation (SIG/SOC2) — artifacts uploaded

Hi Jane —

Per Sofia's timeline, we uploaded the requested artifacts to the secure Drive folder and included a short bundle in the S3 pre-signed package. Summary of what we provided:

1) hsm-attestation-2028-04-30.pdf — vendor-signed attestation for our HSM cluster (serials redacted to match our internal mapping).
2) rotation-logs-redacted-2027-05_to_2028-04.csv — contains rotation_id, wrapped_key_id, rotation_timestamp (UTC), operator_role, and rotation_type (scheduled|emergency). No plaintext key material included.
3) key-custody-matrix.xlsx — role-based custody matrix and a brief break-glass runbook.
4) architecture-note-tenant-crypto.pdf — sequence diagram showing DEK generation per-tenant and envelope-wrapping by rotating master-wrapping keys.

Links/Access:
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-acme-evidence
- S3 pre-signed bundle (48h expiry): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-acme-evidence/ACME-2028-T1?X-Amz-Example
- DocuSign: envelope EXAMPLE12345 includes the HSM attestation signature acknowledgement (for your records).

Please confirm receipt and let us know if you need the raw audit records (we can provide under a scoped access token and additional NDAs). If this satisfies the SIG intake, we can mark the artifact set as delivered and close the ask.

Regards,
David Kim
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hsm-attestation-2028-04-30.pdf (PDF), rotation-logs-redacted-2027-05_to_2028-04.csv (CSV), key-custody-matrix.xlsx (XLSX)
